name: Marco Rubio
desc: 72nd United States Secretary of State since 2025
summary: Marco Antonio Rubio ( ROO-bee-oh; born May 28, 1971) is an American politician, attorney, and diplomat serving as the 72nd United States secretary of state since 2025. He is also serving as the 30th United States national security advisor. A member of the Republican Party, Rubio represented Florida in the United States Senate from 2011 to 2025.
